Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular options for everyday city and hybrid riding are the Polygon Path Series and the Polygon Heist Series.
The Polygon Path Series (such as the Path 3 or Path 4) features a lightweight alloy frame, rigid fork, and swift road-style geometry. It is built purely for fast, low-maintenance urban commuting and efficient pavement riding.
The Polygon Heist Series (such as the Heist 2, 5, or 7) is a dual-sport hybrid equipped with a front suspension fork and wider all-terrain tires. This makes it ideal if your daily routes include rough roads, gravel paths, light trails, or uneven pavement.
If your everyday riding is primarily on smooth city streets and paved bike paths, the Polygon Path will give you a faster, lower-maintenance ride. If you encounter rougher roads or want the flexibility to take on light dirt and gravel paths on the weekends, the Polygon Heist is the better choice for you.
